status: NON-EXECUTABLE EDITORIAL RESEARCH ONLY; DRAFT PR; NOT wired into app, deployed, or offline; no localStorage/user data accessed
scope: Ten new individually sourced Commons photo file-page metadata records, two each for Guyana, Suriname, Paraguay, Uruguay and Ecuador. Different subjects/photographers selected where possible; no photo binaries bundled.
method: Read the exact Commons File pages and their source/author/licence descriptions on 24 October 2026. Checked against existing main and draft editorial photo registry file pages. File-level metadata audit is not a pixel-level, complete copyright-chain or adaptation-rights clearance.
displayRequirements: Before publication inspect actual rendered pixels, file history and current licence; show creator, exact Commons file-page link, licence URL, and modifications visibly. Observe ShareAlike when adapting images. Country gateway pin may be at a different location from photographed site.
